besluite.fout: 'Net soos ons het die boere' first reads as 'just as we have the farmers', because 'ons het' looks like subject and verb.
besluite.rede: A comma after the preposed comparison removes a real misreading for a Grade 5 reader without changing a word of the meaning.
'By latere gemeenskappe en vandag nog' is one compound adverbial and reads clearly; AWS 2017 puts no comma before 'en' between parts of one sentence.
'weet watter plant om te gebruik' is accepted, natural Afrikaans (like 'weet wat om te doen'); the clause with 'hy of sy moet' is only longer, a lateral move.

'watter plante om te soek' is natural Afrikaans and 'hulle' clearly points to the plants just named; the proposal adds the obligation 'moes' and a new 'hulle' for the people, so it is longer and shifts nuance without fixing a real fault.
